events.title: IBM AS/400 announced
events.summary: IBM announced the Application System/400 on June 21, 1988 — an integrated business computer with a single-level store and OS/400.
events.about: The AS/400 (later IBM i) ran RPG and COBOL business apps on hardware IBM upgraded for decades without breaking software — a model of backward compatibility enterprise IT valued. Thousands of banks, manufacturers, and retailers still run workloads on its descendants. Backend developers in IBM midrange shops learned RPG, DB2, and green-screen terminals on this platform.

narrative.whyChosen: The AS/400 was IBM's flagship integrated business system for small and mid-sized enterprises.
narrative.whyImportant: It demonstrated extreme software compatibility across hardware generations in production datacenters.
narrative.problemSolved: Mid-market businesses needed reliable, integrated business computing without mainframe complexity.
